scope: registered gas-phase r2SCAN-3c drafts for exact ordinary water and ethanol structures

special_rules.generic_default: Do not infer charge or multiplicity outside an exact registered structure rule.
special_rules.oxygen: O=O requires a separate electronic-state policy and is not a default singlet.
special_rules.alcohol: 酒精 is not an unconditional identity alias for pure ethanol.
special_rules.solvent: A solvent mention is not the target molecule unless the molecule field names water explicitly.
